Return the package-directory area and file count. Order by files descending, then area ascending.

events.sql: WITH RECURSIVE reachable(file_id) AS (SELECT i.file_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.imports AS i WHERE i.imported_file_id = 'auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py' UNION SELECT i.file_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.imports AS i INNER JOIN reachable AS r ON i.imported_file_id = r.file_id) SELECT x.area, COUNT(DISTINCT x.file_id) AS files FROM (SELECT f.file_id, CASE WHEN len(string_split(f.file_id, '/')) >= 2 THEN split_part(f.file_id, '/', 1) || '/' || split_part(f.file_id, '/', 2) ELSE f.file_id END AS area FROM reachable AS r INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f ON f.file_id = r.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE AND f.file_id <> 'auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py') AS x GROUP BY x.area ORDER BY files DESC, x.area ASC;

gold_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE importers(file_id) AS (
  SELECT i.file_id FROM code.imports i
  WHERE i.imported_file_id = 'auto_ontology/semantic/constants.py'
  UNION
  SELECT i.file_id FROM code.imports i
  JOIN importers m ON i.imported_file_id = m.file_id
)
SELECT split_part(f.file_id, '/', 1) || '/' || split_part(f.file_id, '/', 2) AS area,
       COUNT(*) AS files
FROM importers m
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = m.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY area
ORDER BY files DESC, area;
